title: Naach Lucky Naach
desc: Ten-year-old Lakshmi dreams of winning a national-level dance competition, but she hesitates to participate when her single mother, Nandini, detests music and dance.

title: Kaho Naa... Pyaar Hai
desc: After the untimely death of her lover, Sonia sinks into depression. She soon moves abroad for a fresh start, unaware of the twisted fate that awaits her.

title: Deva
desc: A police officer investigates the murder of his close friend. However, he suffers a traumatic accident that wipes away his memory, jeopardising the investigation.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, who once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces and chart out an inspirational path of freedom against the despotic rulers.
